status: Exploratory reviewer-directed revision; choices recorded after original outcomes and before follow-up outcomes; no preregistration claim
reference: 30-channel scalp average; three recorded EOG channels retain original reference
guard_constraints: Original endpoint and baseline constraints, compared with closest correction restricted to DFT frequencies <=30 Hz
filter: fourth-order Butterworth forward-backward on continuous 256-Hz data; finite zero-phase offline operation
decoder: 100-ms channel means from 0 to 0.8 s; development-fitted scaling and shrinkage LDA with equal class priors
conformal_score: maximum absolute parent-relative deviation, scaled by declared tolerances, across both tasks and voltage/frozen-decoder BA endpoints, for the seven operations explicitly listed in calibration_family; diagnostic guards and mapping are excluded
interpretation: Parent-relative measured endpoint stability and digital known-voltage response. No latent neural ground truth or physical acquisition calibration. Tolerances are engineering examples, not clinical acceptance thresholds.
independent_model: IC-U-Net published checkpoint at AIEEG commit 7f4f27dbf79c0909a0993f680209cf24c32f7791; strict tensor loading; 4-s genuine-recording context; template-montage spherical spline mapping and matched mapping-only control
metadata_clarification: 2026-10-09: corrected an inherited description that said eight nonparent teachers; the executed algorithm already used the seven explicit calibration_family entries. No numerical parameter, participant, candidate, or endpoint changed.
